title: Margherita Flatbread Pizzas
steps:
Oven to 450.
Naan on a sheet pan,
brush with olive oil

Sauce, sliced tomato,
torn mozzarella,
a little parmesan

Bake 10-12 minutes,
top with basil,
cut into wedges
vo: Pizza night, on the table in about twenty minutes.
You need naan, pizza sauce, fresh mozzarella, tomatoes and basil.
Heat the oven to four fifty. Put the naan on a sheet pan and brush it with olive oil.
Spread the sauce, add sliced tomatoes and torn mozzarella, and sprinkle a little parmesan.
Bake ten to twelve minutes, top with basil, and cut into wedges.
